rule: seed = every L/N/P/S glyph named by any surveys-v1 record (all types, all 7 surveys, plus capture-corrections), minus ≈⟂⊥ and variation selectors; tail = the pilot's long-tail sampler, sized at the pilot's dilution ratio 90/188 of the seed count. Lineage per glyph: survey-seed | uniform-tail.
